       INTERVENOR GEORGE NOELKE’S REQUESTED CORRECTIONS TO SOAH
                       ORDER 30 AND EXHIBIT LIST

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES: ​
​
Intervenor in 59475 and 59182, George Noelke ("Noelke") participated in the pre-trial conference on June
5, 2026. Based on the instructions provided by the Honorable ALJ’s at that proceeding he respectfully
requests the corrections below related to SOAH Order No. 30 (Item 5835) and his timely filed Exhibit
List and Designation of Witnesses (Item 5484)

I. EXHIBITS

Noelke submits the following corrected exhibit list:



    Exhibit No.                                         Description

    Noelke Exhibit No. 1                                Applicants’ Response to George Noelke’s First
                                                        Request for Information (Item 5381)


This correction is necessary because this Court advised all parties at the pre-trial conference that
statements of position should not be included as an exhibit. Noelke’s previous Exhibit No. 1 was his
statement of position. Noelke’s revised Exhibit No. 1 is now Applicants’ response to his First Request for



                                                                                                         1
 Information (Item 5381). This document was filed by the Applicants on the Interchange on June 1, 2026,
and uploaded by Noelke to Kiteworks on June 5, 2026 before the start of the prehearing conference and to
Egnyte during that proceeding. If this is considered a late filing, Noelke notes that Applicants stated no
objection at the prehearing conference, and, in any event, this Court reserved taking objections on the
admission of exhibits until the commencement of the hearing on the merits on June 8, 2026. Therefore,
there is no harm to Applicants.

Noelke thus respectfully requests that his name be included on the Attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30,
and he moves for the admission of Noelke Exh. No. 1, Applicants’ response to his First Request for
Information. Noelke anticipates no objection from Applicants because this document qualifies as a
response to discovery, which this Court identified as acceptable in its Order No. 30, page 2.

II. IDENTIFICATION OF WITNESSES

Noelke makes no corrections to his earlier filed identification of witnesses. He does not intend to call any
witnesses to testify during the hearing on the merits. Further, he does not identify any witness for
cross-examination during that hearing.

III. ATTACHMENT B, ORDER OF CROSS EXAMINATION, ORDER NO. 30

Noelke is identified in Attachment B of Order No. 30 as No. 472. However, he has not listed any party to
cross, and no party has listed him to cross. He reserves further argument to post hearing briefing and
exceptions to this Court’s Proposal for Decision since this Court instructed at the prehearing conference
that it would not permit reservations to call witnesses at the hearing on the merits due to time constraints.

Signed June 6, 2026

Respectfully submitted,​
/s/ George Noelke​
George Noelke​
Intervenor​
Pro se Landowner​
​
CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

I certify that a true and correct copy of the foregoing document was served on all parties and counsel of
record on June 5, 2026 with PUC Procedural Rule 22.74 and Orders issued in Docket No. 59182 and
59475.

/s/George Noelke​
George Noelke
